title_cyr: Гоце ми отиде во Солуна града
title_latin: Goce mi otide vo Soluna grada
title_en: Goce went to the city of Solun

lines.cyr: Гоце ми отиде во Солуна града,
lines.lat: Goce mi otide vo Soluna grada,
lines.en: Goce went to the city of Solun1

lines.cyr: во Солуна града, во ладна мејана.
lines.lat: vo Soluna grada, vo ladna mejana.
lines.en: at the city of Solun, in a cold tavern.
He was served by a beautiful Solunian
beautiful maiden, a gorgeous Macedonian.
Goce looked quite worried,

lines.cyr: чаша му стои полна со ракија.
lines.lat: čaša mu stoi polna so rakija.
lines.en: his glass was still full of rakija2 .
So the beautiful Solunian girl started to ask him:

lines.cyr: -Зошто си, бре Гоце, чаша не подигаш?
lines.lat: -Zošto si, bre Goce, čaša ne podigaš?
lines.en: - Hey Goce, why aren't you raising your glass?

lines.cyr: Дали ти е, Гоце, пушка омрзнала,
lines.lat: Dali ti e, Goce, puška omrznala,
lines.en: is it cause Goce, your gun got frozen,
or is it cause Goce, your saber has rusted?
- Hey deary, beautiful maiden,

lines.cyr: штом ме прашаш, моме, право ќе ти кажам.
lines.lat: štom me prašaš, mome, pravo ḱe ti kažam.
lines.en: since you are asking me deary, I will tell you truthfully.
Yesterday evening I went to the city of Kukush3 ,

lines.cyr: и си поминав во Чучук маала,
lines.lat: i si pominav vo Čučuk maala,
lines.en: I strolled by at the neighbourhood of Chuchuk,

lines.cyr: там' си ја видов мојата мајка,
lines.lat: tam' si ja vidov mojata majka,
lines.en: there I saw my mother,
my mother, all dressed in black.
My mother is mourning me while I'm still alive,

lines.cyr: мене ме жали за мојата младост.
lines.lat: mene me žali za mojata mladost.
lines.en: she is mourning me for my youth.
My old father walks by unshaven,

lines.cyr: мене живо жали за мојата младост,
lines.lat: mene živo žali za mojata mladost,
lines.en: he is mourning me for my youth, while I'm still alive,
my brothers are squeezing their revolvers,

lines.cyr: в планина ќе одат, борба да водат,
lines.lat: v planina ḱe odat, borba da vodat,
lines.en: they'll go up the mountains, to charge the battle,
to charge the battle for Macedonia,
for Macedonia to be free.
